cards.other: The bonds of brotherhood run deeper than any ocean!

cards.name: Ultraman Blu
cards.subtitle: Aqua
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Twice per turn) Exile one scene card in your discard area from the game → Give one of your 『BLU』 or 『ROSSO』 +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: The younger brother will travel the road paved by his family — into the stars.

cards.name: Ultraman Arc
cards.subtitle: Solis Armor
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one 『ARC』 card with TYPE 【SPEED】 or 【ARMED】 from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area. If you put a card into your hand with this effect, discard one card from your hand.
cards.other: A Hero with the "Power of the Sun." That is what he dreamed of as a boy.

cards.name: Ultraman Arc
cards.subtitle: Luna Armor
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one 『ARC』 card with TYPE 【POWER】 or 【ARMED】 from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area. If you put a card into your hand with this effect, discard one card from your hand.
cards.other: A Hero with the "Power of the Moon." That is what he imagined as a boy.

cards.name: Ultraman Arc
cards.subtitle: Galaxy Armor
cards.effect: [TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Select a level 3 『ARC』 card with TYPE 【POWER】 or 【SPEED】 in your discard area → Send a level 3 card from the top of another one of your DOUBLE or TRIPLE 『ARC』 to its owner's discard area, then put the selected card into play in its place.
cards.other: A Hero with the endless possibilities of the universe. That is what he dreams of being to this very day.

cards.name: Ultraman Arc
cards.subtitle: Saturn Armor
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may discard one card from your hand, to give one of your 『ARC』 with TYPE 【POWER】 a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: It doesn't matter whether it's possible or impossible. Can you imagine victory?

cards.name: Ultraman Arc
cards.subtitle: Galaxy Armor
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may discard one card from your hand, to give one of your 『ARC』 with TYPE 【SPEED】 a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: Imagination does not only carry us to far-off worlds — it lets us find the hidden side of the world we live in.

cards.name: Ultraman Dyna
cards.subtitle: Flash Type
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: No matter the odds, you can count on Dyna to deliver a "Super Fine Play"!

cards.name: Ultraman Dyna
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: In the aftermath of the battle, he stood, comforting and optimistic. The world would keep turning, and he would remain in our hearts.

cards.name: Ultraman Agul
cards.subtitle: V1
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck, and if you have 『GAIA』 , you may give this character +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Earth's oceans remain unconquered by humanity.

cards.name: Ultraman Agul
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may put the top card of another one of your DOUBLE or TRIPLE 『AGUL』 or 『GAIA』 into your hand, to draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: An inflexible heart became an unshakable conscience when Agul accepted Gaia and humanity.

cards.name: Ultraman Mebius
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may send the top three cards of your deck to your discard area. If you sent a 『HIKARI』 card to your discard area with this effect, you may give this character +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: "Good fortune and prosperity!" the strange statue's stone fish continued to chirp, even as Mebius struggled against it.

cards.name: Hunter Knight Tsurugi
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one Ultra Hero card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: Grief is a shackle on the heart — one that could not hold Ultraman Hikari forever.

cards.name: Ultraman Hikari
cards.effect: 《When this card is sent to your discard area from your deck》 You may discard one card from your hand, to put this card into play on top of one of your 『HIKARI』 that is able to level up with it. If you discarded a 『MEBIUS』 card with this effect, you may give one of your characters +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Despite Kodaigon the Other's jolly looks, it was too tough for Mebius or Hikari to defeat alone.

cards.name: Ultraman Blazar
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may return one card from your hand to the top or bottom of your deck. If you returned a card to the top of your deck with this effect, draw a card at the end of this turn.
cards.other: Zangill had been many things through the millennia — Swordsman, fool, braggart. Blazar would remember him as a hero.

cards.name: Ultraman Blazar
cards.subtitle: Tilsonite Sword
cards.effect: [TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may give this character's battle opponent a BP grade decrease by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: Blazar held the sword out and bowed, as if showing respect to the foe he must battle against.

cards.name: What We Have to Protect
cards.effect: 《When this scene enters play》 If you have 『ROSSO』 , you may discard one card from your hand, to draw a card. When you draw with this effect, if you have 『BLU』 , you may give one of your 『ROSSO』 or 『BLU』 +1000 BP for this turn.

cards.name: Ultraman
cards.subtitle: Ultra Hero
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: Ultraman swings his mighty fist, sending Gigantron to the ground in a single punch!

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: Ginga's glowing hand is a guiding light towards the future!

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: In the dense forests of Furuhoshi, Ultraman Ginga battled the monster servants of Dark Lugiel.

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.other: Hikaru Raido's bond with Ultraman Ginga may have begun before they ever met...

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: Ginga's hands stretch wide, gathering the endless possibilities before unleashing them!

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Ginga's body shines in the darkness — a beacon to help you follow your dreams.

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.other: Even in the darkness of space, Ginga pursues dreams of peace!

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While you have two or more DOUBLE Ultra Heroes, this character's BP grade increases by 1. Additionally, while you have four or more DOUBLE Ultra Heroes, give this character +1000 BP.
cards.other: Ginga can change size from microscopic size to as big as you can dream!

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 If you have two or more DOUBLE Ultra Heroes, you may give this character +2000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: At times, Ginga had to battle his own loved ones to free them from the insidious power of the Dark Spark.

cards.name: Ultraman Ginga
cards.other: The light of Ginga can be found in the stars we wish upon to guide our paths.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one Ultra Hero card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: In the mysterious ruins, Nexus awaits the next brave human to inherit his light.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Anphans
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【ARMED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Nexus's power is passed between his hosts, the Deunamists.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Anphans
cards.other: What does it mean, to be Heroic?

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw a card. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the top or bottom of your deck.
cards.other: When the Over Ray Schtrom is released, all of Nexus's power is expelled to erase the threat.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Junis
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: In a world where trust was more alien than any invader, Kazuki Komon chose to put his faith in that giant.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Junis
cards.other: Nexus's Junis form is stronger than Anphans, but can still continue to grow stronger.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Junis
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may send one opponent's scene to its owner's discard area, or return one scene card from your discard area to the top or bottom of your deck, to give one of your Ultra Heroes +2000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: In the unearthly light of the Meta Field, those that would threaten the universe meet their end at Nexus's hand.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Junis
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to send up to two of them to your discard area, and return the rest to the top of your deck in any order.
cards.other: If a Space Beast threatens terrible destruction, Nexus summons the Meta Field to keep humanity safe.

cards.name: Ultraman Nexus
cards.subtitle: Junis
cards.other: Photographer Jun Himeya accepted the Light so that he would never again have to see the pain in a child's eyes.

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Spacium Zeperion
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: Under the light of the moon, a century ago, the hero lost his original form. To fight, he uses the power of those who came before him.

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Spacium Zeperion
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Between Ultraman and Tiga, Orb follows in the footsteps of trailblazing giants!

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Spacium Zeperion
cards.other: Spacium Zeperion's techniques blend dependable skill with the boundless mystery of the ancient past.

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: The Sparion Beam struck Maga-Basser, and the Lord Monster was undone.

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Burnmite
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Burnmite combines the power of Mebius and Taro to generate explosive power — literally!

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Hurricane Slash
cards.other: A mastery of weapons and the speed to wield them — that is the legacy Orb received from Jack and Zero.

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Spacium Zeperion
cards.effect: [TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards, to give one of your 『ORB』 +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Orb is a noble hero, here to protect Earth from the unsealed Lord Monsters!

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Hurricane Slash
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Discard one card from your hand → If the discarded card is a character card, give one of your 『ORB』 +1000 BP for this turn. Otherwise, give one of your 『ORB』 +2000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Orb wields the Orb Slugger Lance in battle!

cards.name: Ultraman Orb
cards.subtitle: Burnmite
cards.other: Burnmite trades some of Orb's speed away for blazing strength!

cards.name: Ultraman Mebius
cards.other: Mebius was the youngest hero to join the Ultra Brothers, the fraternity of heroes that protect Earth!

cards.name: Ultraman Mebius
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] While you have 10 or more cards in your discard area, give this character +1000 BP. Additionally, while you have 20 or more cards in your discard area, give this character +1000 BP.
cards.other: Mebius is kindhearted and friendly, even among the Ultras — but that doesn't mean he can't fight.

cards.name: Ultraman Mebius
cards.subtitle: Mebium Knight Blade
cards.effect: [TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may send the top three cards of your deck to your discard area. If you sent a card to your discard area with this effect, draw a card, then discard one card from your hand.
cards.other: Mebius honed his swordsmanship through battles alongside and against mighty warriors!

cards.name: Ultraman Zero
cards.effect: [SIN] For each 『ZERO』 you have, give this character +1000 BP.
cards.other: Even with his powers sealed away by his damaged bracelet, Zero resolved to fight Belial.

cards.name: Ultraman Zero Beyond
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may give one of your characters with TYPE 【POWER】 or 【ARMED】 +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Zero can control each one of his "Quattro Sluggers" as easily as his own limbs!

cards.name: Ultraman Zero Beyond
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【ARMED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Mild-mannered salaryman Leito Igaguri's life was hijacked when Ultraman Zero needed a host to fight on Earth!

cards.name: Ultraman Zero
cards.other: The Ultimate Bracelet was damaged in a cowardly sneak attack, preventing Zero from changing form... at first.

cards.name: Ultraman Zero Beyond
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Discard one card from your hand → Give one of your 『GEED』 with TYPE 【BASIC】 or 【POWER】 a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: Zero still has access to the Zero Twin Sword — in fact, as Zero Beyond, he can even create a second!

cards.name: Ultraman Zero Beyond
cards.effect: [TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may discard one card from your hand, to draw a card.
cards.other: If you're 20,000 years too early to beat Zero normally, how long would it take to beat Zero Beyond...?

cards.name: Ultraman Zero
cards.other: Zero's legend is only just beginning!

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Primitive
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may return the top card of one of your DOUBLE 『GEED』 to its owner's hand, to give one of your characters +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Geed's "B-Factor", inherited from his father, is not inherently evil — but it is powerful.

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Primitive
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: If Riku had never met Pega, Laiha, Leito, Zero, Moa... Would he have turned out just like Belial?

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Acro Smasher
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Acro Smasher's fighting style is fluid and mobile, and must use the Geed Claw to deliver lethal blows.

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Solid Burning
cards.other: Metal armor and energy vents put the "solid" in Solid Burning!

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Magnificent
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Discard one card from your hand → If this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 or 【ARMED】 , give that character a BP grade decrease by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: With the speed and strength of the titans he idolizes, Geed Magnificent strides forth!

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Magnificent
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Send the top card of your deck to your discard area → If the sent card has TYPE 【POWER】 or 【ARMED】 , give one of your Ultra Heroes TYPE 【POWER】 for this turn.
cards.other: Geed Magnificent was strong enough to easily defeat even an enhanced Pedanium Zetton.

cards.name: Ultraman Geed
cards.subtitle: Magnificent
cards.other: Zero and Father of Ultra see the hero Belial could have been in his son.

cards.name: Ultraman Z
cards.subtitle: Alpha Edge
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may give one of your Ultra Heroes with TYPE 【POWER】 +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Alpha Edge allows Z to channel the secret techniques of Space Martial Arts, with his own spin on them.

cards.name: Ultraman Z
cards.subtitle: Beta Crescent Slash
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Send one of your scene to its owner's discard area → Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Put one 『Z』 from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: Z prefers martial techniques when he uses Beta Smash, but his energy techniques are no less impressive!

cards.name: Ultraman Z
cards.subtitle: Gamma Future
cards.other: Gamma Future possesses incredible techniques that could easily be mistaken for actual magic.

cards.name: Ultraman Decker
cards.subtitle: Miracle Type
cards.effect: [DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one 『DECKER』 with TYPE 【POWER】 or 【ARMED】 from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area. If you put a card into your hand with this effect, discard one card from your hand.
cards.other: To keep hope during an unending crisis... That in itself is a kind of miracle, no?

cards.name: Ultraman Decker
cards.subtitle: Strong Type
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 If you have a TRIPLE Ultra Hero, you may give this character +3000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Decker emerged from the cloud cover, HANE2's piloting allowing him to focus his energy into his fist...

cards.name: Ultraman Decker
cards.subtitle: Flash Type
cards.other: Decker's power comes from the same future that the Spheres hail from.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one Kaiju card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: The greatest shame of the Land of Light.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: He is ruled by his ambition, dragged back to life again and again.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: His crimes took him to a place where his heart could not survive.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: He will discard anyone and anything for a scrap more of power.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.subtitle: Giga Battlenizer
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: The Giga Battlenizer was sealed in the deepest part of the Monster Graveyard, waiting to be returned to its true master.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.subtitle: Giga Battlenizer
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: It was Belial's son, Ultraman Geed, that brought him to Earth the first time.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: No amount of lives taken or bounty seized will ever satisfy him.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: "Evil" is difficult to quantify — and yet, one look at him and all you can think is "evil".

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP][Activate] (Once per turn) Discard one card from your hand that is not an Ultra Hero card → Give one of your 『BELIAL』 , or one of your Kaiju with printed EXTRA BP, a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: When Belial escaped from his prison, he immediately laid siege to the Land of Light to take the Plasma Spark.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: His hands — no, claws — can only gouge and tear now.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: The serene face of an Ultra has been twisted into a vicious grin.

cards.name: Ultraman Belial
cards.other: To stand below Belial is to invite being crushed.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may draw two cards. When you draw with this effect, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: His presence on Earth was a challenge to Orb — to stop Juggler, he would have to become as bad as him.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【ARMED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: The Dark Ring in his hand is a mockery of the Orb Ring, spewing darkness.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.other: Suave, sophisticated... and utterly ruthless.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 You may reveal the top five cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand, and send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: His blade is as long and as wicked as his schemes.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.
cards.other: Juggler was not chosen to gain the power of Ultraman, but this did not mean he lacked skill.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.other: Juggler's skill with the blade came from the Jashin Style school of swordplay.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [DBL][TRP] 《When this character enters play》 You may choose one card at random from an opponent's hand, to reveal it. If the revealed card is a character card, give the battle opponent of one of your 『JUGGLUS JUGGLER』 a BP grade decrease by 1 for this turn. (*The revealed card returns to its previous state.)
cards.other: Juggler was not naturally capable of becoming a giant, so when he did so, it was to maximize the destruction he caused.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [TRP] 《When this character enters play》 Your opponent may draw a card. When they draw with this effect, draw a card.
cards.other: Power felt empty — it could not give him the redemption, the recognition he sought.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.other: A hedonistic man, his frivolity hid a deep sadness.

cards.name: Alien Baltan
cards.effect: [SIN] 《When this character enters play》 You may discard one card from your hand, to draw a card.
cards.other: The "Space Ninja" has fought Ultraman to try and claim Earth as their new home countless times.

cards.name: Alien Baltan
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL][Activate] (Once per turn) Send the top three cards of each player's deck to their discard area → For every two Kaiju cards from among them, give this character +1000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: Baltan's duplicates were no more than illusions — not that they were any less dangerous.

cards.name: Gomora
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【BASIC】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: Gomora — a prehistoric Kaiju that has survived to the modern era.

cards.name: Gomora
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] For every two cards in an opponent's hand, give this character +1000 BP.
cards.other: Emerging from hibernation can make anyone grumpy.

cards.name: Zetton
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: The Alien Zetton's capsule detonated, releasing Ultraman's final foe.

cards.name: Zetton
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent's BP grade is increased, this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: Against the setting sun, the end of the world walks.

cards.name: Eleking
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【ARMED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: The old fisherman thought he'd caught dinner — instead, he'd almost fished up a Kaiju!

cards.name: Eleking
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] 《When this character enters play》 If you are the Lead player for this turn, you may choose this character's battle opponent. If you do, opponent's cannot resolve the chosen character's 《When this character enters play》 effect for this turn.
cards.other: Eleking's leathery form belies a terrifying electrical power!

cards.name: Kyrieloid
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【BASIC】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: The Kyriel thought themselves to be humanity's shepherds — and sheep are meant to obey.

cards.name: Kyrieloid II
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent is 『TIGA』 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: The returning Kyrieloid attempted to convince humanity that Tiga was the devilish interloper, not him.

cards.name: Kyrieloid II
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: Against Tiga's Power Type, Kyrieloid II's body swelled with muscle, wicked blades emerging from its arms.

cards.name: Kyrieloid II
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.
cards.other: Against Tiga's Sky Type, Kyrieloid II's body sprouted leathery wings to allow it to pursue the giant by air.

cards.name: Dark Mephisto
cards.effect: [SIN] While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.

cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【BASIC】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>

cards.name: Neronga
cards.effect: [SIN]《When this character enters play》If this character's battle opponent is an Ultra Hero, you may give this character +2000 BP for this turn.
cards.other: This electricity-eating kaiju bends light to make itself invisible!

cards.name: Neronga
cards.effect: [DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Give one of your RED Kaiju with TYPE 【HAZARD】 a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: Neronga had no understanding of humanity's need for electricity — it saw a meal, and came to eat!

cards.name: Neronga
cards.effect: [DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Give one of your RED Kaiju with TYPE 【HAZARD】 a BP grade increase by 1 for this turn.
cards.other: The kaiju is there, bending the light around it — Are your eyes sharp enough to catch sight of it?

cards.name: Antlar
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: A terrifying insectoid Kaiju with magnetic powers. Human weapons cannot hope to penetrate its exoskeleton.

cards.name: Antlar
cards.subtitle: Magnetic Beam
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL]<u>For each RED Kaiju with TYPE 【HAZARD】 you have, give this character +1000 BP.</u>
cards.other: In the sands of lost Baradhi, a terrifying kaiju stalked the night. Only the blue stone left by the God of Noah could hope to defeat it.

cards.name: Telesdon
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: The Subterran's Kaiju weapon, Telesdon was a firebreathing subterranean behemoth!

cards.name: Erimaki-Telesdon
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: Telesdon was mixed with Jirahs' Medal, gaining a number of new powers in the process.

cards.name: Deathfacer
cards.effect: [SIN]《When this character enters play》If this character's battle opponent is an Ultra Hero, you may give this character's battle opponent -2000 BP for this turn. (*BP will not be less than 0)
cards.other: A "perfect existence, unswayed by emotions." Emotions like compassion, mercy, sense.
cards.filmography: ULTRAMAN TIGA & ULTRAMAN DYNA: WARRIORS OF THE STAR OF LIGHT

cards.filmography: ULTRAMAN TIGA & ULTRAMAN DYNA: WARRIORS OF THE STAR OF LIGHT

cards.other: That coursing energy, that thrumming sound... Dyna had heard it in his nightmares before...
cards.filmography: ULTRAMAN TIGA & ULTRAMAN DYNA: WARRIORS OF THE STAR OF LIGHT

cards.effect: [SIN]《When this character enters play》If this character's battle opponent is an Ultra Hero, you may give this character's battle opponent -2000 BP for this turn. (*BP will not be less than 0)
cards.other: The Alien Monera may have lost their pawns, but they had their own ship, and their own wicked powers!
cards.filmography: ULTRAMAN TIGA & ULTRAMAN DYNA: WARRIORS OF THE STAR OF LIGHT

cards.name: Queen Monera
cards.effect: [DBL]<u>While you have nine or more Kaiju cards with TYPE 【INVASION】 in your discard area, this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>

cards.filmography: ULTRAMAN TIGA & ULTRAMAN DYNA: WARRIORS OF THE STAR OF LIGHT

cards.name: Lidorias

cards.effect: [DBL]Give all 『COSMOS』 (*yours and your opponent's) -2000 BP each. (*BP will not be less than 0)
cards.other: The Chaos-Header corrupted the kind Kaiju into a ravenous monster...

cards.name: Alien Baltan
cards.subtitle: Basical Version
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: The children of Planet Baltan needed a new home. It would do anything to give them one.

cards.name: Neo Baltan
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Look at cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of 「Baltan」 you have on your field, and return those cards to the top of your deck in any order.
cards.other: The Baltan felt it must discard its compassion to protect its people. But how could it ever return to them after...?

cards.name: Neo Baltan
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Look at cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of 「Baltan」 you have on your field, and return those cards to the top of your deck in any order.
cards.other: All it had left were the children. Even if it couldn't win, it had to do whatever it took to ensure they could grow up.

cards.name: Neo Baltan
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【SPEED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: The Baltan honed its body until every inch was a weapon.

cards.name: Inpelaizer
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【ARMED】 , this character's BP becomes EXTRA.</u>
cards.other: Mebius and GUYS had fought dozens of Kaiju, but this robot — this was new.

cards.effect: [DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Give this character +2000 BP for this turn.

cards.name: Inpelaizer
cards.effect: [DBL][Activate](Once per turn)Flip your 〖ANY:1〗 face-down, or discard one card from your hand → Give this character +2000 BP for this turn.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While you have two or more PURPLE 『JUGGLUS JUGGLER』 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.</u>
cards.other: If it would let him defeat Orb, Juggler would even accept the power of the Great Devourer...!

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN]<u>While this character's battle opponent has TYPE 【POWER】 , this character's BP grade increases by 1.</u>
cards.other: The last piece was complete, and the Great Devourer would soon be free. Would this... finally make Gai understand?

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.other: Juggler schemes endlessly to reveal the darkness in Gai's heart — to prove that Ultraman Orb is no better than he is.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL]《When this character enters play》You may reveal cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of different card names among your characters. If you do, put one card from among them into your hand. Then, send the rest to your discard area. If you put a card into your hand with this effect, and this character is SINGLE, return one card from your hand to the bottom of your deck.
cards.other: In the blood-red night of the moon, a man tried to fill the bottomless emptiess in his heart with malice, ignoring the sliver of light still there.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.effect: [DBL]《When this character enters play》You may flip your 〖PURPLE:1〗 face-down. If you do, give this character's battle opponent -2000 BP for this turn. (*BP will not be less than 0)
cards.other: Juggler was grateful for Don Nostra's "patronage." He would make far better use of the Dark King's card than the Planetary Invasion Coalition would.

cards.name: Jugglus Juggler
cards.other: His swordsmanship is a reflection of his soul — impossible to predict.

cards.name: Zeppandon

cards.other: Juggler's monstrous impulses ran wild — if Gai wanted to defeat Zeppandon, he'd have to prove Juggler's worldview right and embrace the darkness.

cards.name: Zeppandon

cards.name: Ultraman Tregear
cards.other: The only side he ever truly fights for is his own.

cards.other: He will not look you in the eye, but he is always staring into your soul. Be mindful of what he may see...

cards.name: Ultraman Tregear
cards.effect: [SIN][DBL][TRP]《When this character enters play》You may reveal the top three cards of your deck, to put one scene card from among them into your hand. Then, send the rest to your discard area.
cards.other: A noble heart, collapsing into despair and depravity. For Tregear, this was beyond ecstasy — this was the vindication of his worldview.

cards.name: Absolute Tartarus
cards.other: His golden body is beautiful, but lacks even a hint of warmth.
